message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|---|-------|------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Stanley Kubrick’s masterful psychological terror with iconic imagery. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | A chilling family saga that blends supernatural dread with raw emotion. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | A smart, socially conscious horror that mixes satire with genuine scares. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Suspense built on silence—perfect for a tense, atmospheric experience. |
| 5 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | A modern supernatural thriller grounded in real‑life paranormal investigations. |
| 6 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | A daylight horror that turns the sunny Swedish festival into a nightmare. |
| 7 | **It Follows** | 2014 | A fresh take on the “invisible threat” trope with a haunting soundtrack. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Psychological horror that explores grief and motherhood. |
| 9 | **The Ring** | 2002 | A remake of the Japanese classic that still delivers a creepy, lingering dread. |
|10 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Low‑budget found‑footage style that keeps you on edge. |
|11 | **The Witch** | 2015 | A slow‑burn, period horror that’s as unsettling as it is beautiful. |
|12 | **Suspiria (2018)** | 2018 | A visually striking remake that amps up the supernatural terror. |
|13 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | A meta‑commentary on horror tropes that still delivers genuine scares. |
|14 | **The Others** | 2001 | A gothic thriller with a twist that keeps you guessing. |
|15 | **Poltergeist** | 1982 | Classic supernatural horror with a mix of family drama and ghostly terror. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you want psychological dread, supernatural chills, or a fresh twist on old tropes. Enjoy the fright!
